snippet.title: Let's Build a Zoo: Amphibian Encounters - Coming to PC 2027
snippet.description:
We've got a brand new DLC coming for Let's Build a Zoo, 'Amphibian Encounters'!
50 new variants of amphibians will be joining your zoo very soon. There are also new shops, enclosures, decorations, enrichment items, plants & more.

And as a gift from us to you, we've also got a FREE content update heading your way too. Both are coming to Steam and Epic in early 2027!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4971550/Lets_Build_a_Zoo_Amphibian_Encounters/
